# frontmatter-schema

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-001 — A closing fence on its own line ends the frontmatter](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-001.md) — When a document starts with a `---` line and a later `---` or `...` line stands alone on its line, the extension SHALL treat the lines between them as the frontmatter block and show it as a properties table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-002 — A document without a closing fence has no frontmatter](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-002.md) — When a document starts with a `---` line but has no closing `---` or `...` line, the extension SHALL treat the document as having no frontmatter and show no properties table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-003 — Frontmatter fences accept Windows line endings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-003.md) — When the fence lines of a document end with CRLF, the extension SHALL read the frontmatter block exactly as it reads one with LF endings.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-004 — The propertiesTable setting hides the table and the raw YAML](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-004.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.propertiesTable` is false, the extension SHALL show neither the properties table nor the raw frontmatter text.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-005 — A table without a schema lists the keys in source order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-005.md) — When the frontmatter has no string `type`, the extension SHALL show a two-column table headed Names and Values that lists the keys in source order, without type icons or a Description column.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-006 — A nested mapping shows as YAML code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-006.md) — When a frontmatter value is a mapping and carries no link, the extension SHALL show it as a YAML code block in the Value cell.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-007 — Boolean values show as read-only checkboxes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-007.md) — When a frontmatter value is a boolean in read mode, the extension SHALL show a checkbox marked aria-disabled and removed from the Tab order, checked for true, followed by the word true or false.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-008 — Long lists are cut after fifty items](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-008.md) — When a frontmatter value is a list in read mode, the extension SHALL show one dash-marked item per line, at most 50 items, followed by "+ N more" for the omitted ones.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-009 — Empty lists and null values show as YAML tokens](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-009.md) — When a frontmatter value is an empty list or null, the extension SHALL show `\[\]` for the empty list and `null` for the null value.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-010 — The properties table has a lean frame](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-010.md) — When the properties table is displayed, the extension SHALL draw it without an outer border and with transparent section, table and cells, apart from translucent grey header cells, the red background of an error row and a title without background.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-011 — The table fits a narrow preview](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-011.md) — When the preview is 640 px wide or less, the extension SHALL lay the properties table out with fixed columns and let names, values, links and type labels wrap anywhere so that nothing pushes the page sideways.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-012 — Every table value is HTML-escaped](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-012.md) — When the properties table is built, the extension SHALL escape every name, value, tooltip and data attribute as text, so that frontmatter cannot inject markup into the page.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-013 — The properties section maps to source line 1](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-013.md) — When the properties table is rendered for a document, the extension SHALL mark its section as source line 1.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-014 — The Description column can be collapsed and restored](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-014.md) — When a writer presses the toggle in a column header of a schema table, the extension SHALL collapse or restore the Description column while keeping Name and Value readable.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-015 — The Description choice is remembered per document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-015.md) — When a writer collapses or expands the Description column, the extension SHALL remember the choice for that document, keep it for the 200 most recent documents and restore it after a refresh.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-016 — Narrow previews start with the Description column collapsed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-016.md) — When a document has no remembered Description choice and the preview is 640 px wide or less at page start, the extension SHALL start with the Description column collapsed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-017 — Invalid YAML gives one error row and an error badge](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-017.md) — When the frontmatter block is not valid YAML, the extension SHALL show one error row "Invalid frontmatter YAML: {parser message}" and an error badge of 1.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-018 — Frontmatter that is not a mapping gives an error row](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-018.md) — When the frontmatter block parses to a list, a scalar or nothing, the extension SHALL show the error row "Invalid frontmatter YAML: Frontmatter is not a mapping.".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-019 — The nearest schema folder is found by walking up](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-019.md) — When a document's frontmatter has a string `type`, the extension SHALL look for the schema folder by walking up from the document's folder to the workspace folder root and use the first `_schema` folder, or `_schemas` when a level has no `_schema`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-020 — The schema file is chosen by the type name](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-020.md) — When the schema folder holds files named `{type}.schema.yaml`, `.yml`, `.json` or `.json5`, the extension SHALL pick the file whose stem equals the type ignoring case, preferring `.yaml`, then `.yml`, `.json`, `.json5`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-021 — A missing schema file is reported as an info row](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-021.md) — When a schema folder exists but holds no file for the document's type, the extension SHALL show the generic table with the info row "No schema found for type "{type}" in {folder}/." and an info badge.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-022 — Schema lookup is off in Restricted Mode and for standalone files](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-022.md) — When the workspace is not trusted or the document is not inside a workspace folder, the extension SHALL not look up a schema for the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-023 — Schema files may be written in YAML, JSON or JSON5](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-023.md) — When a schema file is written in YAML, JSON or JSON5, the extension SHALL load it, stripping line and block comments outside strings from JSON and JSON5 files.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-024 — Relative schema references are inlined from the schema folder](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-024.md) — When a schema node is exactly a relative `$ref` to another schema file of the schema folder, the extension SHALL replace the node with the content of that file, trying the name as written then `.json`, `.json5`, `.yaml` and `.yml`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-025 — A schema that cannot be parsed gives a warning row](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-025.md) — When a JSON or JSON5 schema file cannot be read or parsed, the extension SHALL show the generic table with the warning row "Schema could not be parsed: {error}" and a warning badge.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-026 — A schema that cannot be compiled gives a red row](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-026.md) — When the validator cannot compile a schema, the extension SHALL show a red alert row "Schema validation failed to run: {diagnostic}" that spans every visible column and counts one error in the badge, while still listing the fields in schema order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-027 — Schema changes are picked up by content](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-027.md) — When a schema file or a file it refers to changes content, the extension SHALL use the new content at the next analysis, comparing content rather than modification time.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-028 — Editing a schema does not refresh open previews by itself](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-028.md) — When a schema file is edited while a preview is open, the extension SHALL leave the table as it is until the next document change, refresh, re-render or settings change.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-029 — A schema table lists declared fields first in schema order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-029.md) — When a document's type has a schema, the extension SHALL show a table with the columns Name, Value and Description that lists the declared fields present in the document in schema order, then the other keys in source order.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-030 — Field names show a type icon and a type label](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-030.md) — When a schema table is displayed, the extension SHALL show before each field name a type icon of at most 1.5 em with the type name as tooltip, and after the name the label "({type})".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-031 — The row tooltip lists title, description, allowed values and issues](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-031.md) — When a schema table row is displayed, the extension SHALL set its tooltip to the schema title, the schema description, the line "Allowed: {values}" for enum fields and every issue message, one per line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-032 — Composed schemas are merged into one field list](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-032.md) — When a schema uses allOf, anyOf, oneOf or if/then/else, the extension SHALL merge the properties of every visited branch into one field list in declaration order, following the if branch that the current values select, and apply the required lists of the visited branches.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-033 — The displayed field type follows the schema declaration](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-033.md) — When a schema table row is built, the extension SHALL display enum for enum or const, datetime, date or time for those formats, boolean, number, list or text for the matching type (the first non-null type of a type list) and unknown otherwise.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-034 — Field names equal to object members are not treated as present](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-034.md) — When a document or a schema uses a field name such as `constructor` or `toString`, the extension SHALL treat the name as present or declared only if it really is.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-035 — A schema error marks the row of its field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-035.md) — When the frontmatter violates its schema, the extension SHALL attach each error to the row of the field concerned with a red underline and the validator message in the row tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-036 — A missing required field gets an empty row with its error](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-036.md) — When a field required by the schema is absent from the frontmatter, the extension SHALL add an empty row for it with the error "Required field "{name}" is missing.".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-037 — An error that names no field becomes a red row of its own](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-037.md) — When a schema error concerns the whole frontmatter and names no field, the extension SHALL add a red row with the validator message under the field rows.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-038 — Missing required fields are summarised under the table](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-038.md) — When required fields are missing, the extension SHALL show a red line under the table that reads "Missing required fields: {names}" in schema order, announced to screen readers.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-039 — The title badge counts the issues](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-039.md) — When the frontmatter has errors or warnings, the extension SHALL show in the table title a badge button with the count of errors then the count of warnings.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-040 — The badge jumps to the first row with an issue](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-040.md) — When a writer presses the title badge, the extension SHALL scroll the first row with an issue to the centre, focus its value cell and highlight it for 1.5 seconds.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-041 — A closed schema reports every undeclared field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-041.md) — When a schema root declares `additionalProperties: false`, the extension SHALL report each undeclared field as the schema error row "must NOT have additional properties", whatever the strict setting.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-042 — The strict setting warns on undeclared fields](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-042.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.strictAdditionalProperties` is true and a schema matched, the extension SHALL warn on each field the schema does not declare with "Unknown field; it is not declared in the "{type}" schema." and count it in the badge.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-043 — The table is refreshed in place 300 ms after the last edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-043.md) — When the frontmatter of the shown document changes, the extension SHALL re-analyse it 300 ms after the last change and replace the properties section on the open page without reloading it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-044 — A new table waits while a field editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-044.md) — When a refreshed properties table arrives while a frontmatter field editor is open, the extension SHALL keep the new markup aside and apply it after the editor closes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-045 — A frontmatter setting change re-analyses the open previews](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-045.md) — When any `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.*` setting changes, the extension SHALL re-read the frontmatter settings of every open preview and re-analyse the table of each preview whose document is the active editor's document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-046 — x-okf-link annotations are found in nested schema positions](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-046.md) — When a schema annotates a property with `x-okf-link`, the extension SHALL find the annotation on top-level and nested properties, array items and prefixItems, patternProperties, additionalProperties, local `$ref`s, every allOf branch, the matching anyOf branches, the single matching oneOf branch and the selected if/then/else branch.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-047 — An invalid x-okf-link annotation marks the field](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-047.md) — When an `x-okf-link` annotation is not an object, has a missing or unknown `resolution` or `syntax`, has a non-string marker, has display field lists that are not lists of names or has a non-boolean `show_line_number`, the extension SHALL mark the field with an error "\[E10\] x-okf-link ... at '{field}'".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-048 — Link values are checked for type and syntax](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-048.md) — When a field annotated with `x-okf-link` holds a non-string value, a wikilink not written `\[\[target\]\]` or `\[\[target|label\]\]`, or an empty target, the extension SHALL mark the field with an E10 error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-049 — Query and fragment are split off a link target](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-049.md) — When a link value carries a `?query` or a `#fragment` after the target, the extension SHALL resolve the target alone and keep the query and the fragment for navigation.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-050 — Document-relative links resolve from the document's folder](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-050.md) — When a link annotation has the resolution `document-relative`, the extension SHALL resolve the target from the folder of the document and accept it only when it names an existing file inside a workspace folder, unless `allowOutsideWorkspaceLinks` is true.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-051 — Bundle-relative links resolve from the bundle root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-051.md) — When a link annotation has the resolution `bundle-relative` or `bundle-relative-stem`, the extension SHALL resolve the target from the bundle root, adding `.md` to the target for the stem form.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-052 — Project-relative links resolve from the project root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-052.md) — When a link annotation has the resolution `project-relative`, the extension SHALL resolve the target from the project root.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-053 — Absolute link targets are refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-053.md) — When a link target is an absolute path in POSIX, drive-letter or UNC form, the extension SHALL refuse it with an E10 error whatever the resolution.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-054 — Bundle and project targets cannot leave their root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-054.md) — When a bundle-relative or project-relative target resolves outside its root, also through a symbolic link, the extension SHALL refuse it with the E10 error "escapes its {resolution} root".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-055 — A filename stem resolves when exactly one file matches](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-055.md) — When a link annotation has the resolution `filename-stem`, the extension SHALL look the stem up among the Markdown files under the workspace folders and the bundle root and accept it when exactly one file matches.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-056 — An ambiguous or unknown stem is an error](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-056.md) — When a filename stem matches several files or none, the extension SHALL report the E10 error "is ambiguous" or "was not found".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-057 — An unreadable stem candidate gives a warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-057.md) — When a filename-stem candidate cannot be read, the extension SHALL report the warning W15 "could not be resolved because the workspace may be unavailable".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-058 — The stem index skips build and hidden folders](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-058.md) — When the Markdown stem index is built, the extension SHALL skip the folders node_modules, .git, _build, .venv, out, dist and output and every folder whose name starts with a dot.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-059 — The stem index is rebuilt when a Markdown file changes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-059.md) — When a Markdown file is created, changed or deleted in a workspace folder, the extension SHALL rebuild the filename-stem index, following added and removed workspace folders.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-060 — The bundleRoot setting sets the bundle root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-060.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.bundleRoot` is a non-empty string, the extension SHALL use that folder as the bundle root, a relative path being taken from the first workspace folder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-061 — The projectRoot setting sets the project root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-061.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.projectRoot` is a non-empty string, the extension SHALL use that folder as the project root, a relative path being taken from the first workspace folder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-062 — The allowOutsideWorkspaceLinks setting default refuses outside links](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-062.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.allowOutsideWorkspaceLinks` is false, the extension SHALL refuse a document-relative link to a file outside every workspace folder with the E10 error "escapes its navigation root".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-063 — A resolving link shows as a link with its tooltip](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-063.md) — When a frontmatter link resolves to a file, the extension SHALL show the value as a keyboard-focusable link whose tooltip starts with the workspace-relative path of the target.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-064 — A link that does not resolve shows its problem](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-064.md) — When a frontmatter link does not resolve, the extension SHALL show the value text followed by an error or warning mark and a plain label.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-065 — Links are shown as pending on the first paint](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-065.md) — When the table is first rendered, the extension SHALL show each annotated link value with its text, a spinner and the status "File links are being resolved", without the Studio link tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-066 — Links are resolved about 150 ms after the render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-066.md) — When a table with pending links has been shown, the extension SHALL resolve the links about 150 ms later and replace the table in place, waiting while a block or field editor is open and dropping results that became stale.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-067 — A link tooltip shows fields of the linked file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-067.md) — When a link annotation lists `tooltip_shows_fields`, the extension SHALL add to the tooltip of the resolved link one "name: value" line per listed field found in the target's frontmatter, counting only string, number and boolean values.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-068 — A link shows an excerpt of the linked file](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-068.md) — When a link annotation lists `preview_shows_fields`, the extension SHALL show beside the resolved link one excerpt made of those field values with whitespace collapsed and joined by "; ", clipped with an ellipsis, with the full text in its own tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-069 — A link can show the line of its marker](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-069.md) — When a link annotation sets `show_line_number: true` and a `basename_marker`, the extension SHALL show "line N" beside the resolved link, N being the 1-based line of the first line of the target that carries the marker followed by the document identity.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-070 — Linked file details refresh when the target changes on disk](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-070.md) — When a displayed linked target is saved, created or deleted on disk, the extension SHALL refresh the link details, through a watcher on each displayed target backed by the preview-wide file watcher.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-071 — A link tooltip appears on hover and focus](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-071.md) — When a writer hovers or focuses a link value that is not pending, the extension SHALL show its full title in a tooltip below it, or above it when there is no room, never under the toolbar and at most 480 px wide.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-072 — A link tooltip closes on leaving, Escape, scroll, resize and outside click](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-072.md) — When a link tooltip is open and the pointer and focus leave the link, or Escape is pressed, or the page scrolls or resizes, or a click lands elsewhere, the extension SHALL close the tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-073 — Activating a resolving link opens its target](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-073.md) — When a writer activates a resolving frontmatter link (click or Enter in read mode, Cmd or Ctrl and click in edit mode), the extension SHALL open the target in the editor at the marker line when the annotation has a `basename_marker`, keeping the query and fragment and recording the jump in the Back and Next history.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-074 — An unusable frontmatter link is not followed](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-074.md) — When a writer activates a frontmatter link that is invalid, unavailable or outside the allowed folders, the extension SHALL not follow it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-075 — The body still renders when the table is off](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-075.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.propertiesTable` is false, the extension SHALL still render the body of the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-076 — Invalid YAML does not stop the body from rendering](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-076.md) — When the frontmatter block is not valid YAML, the extension SHALL still render the Markdown body below the properties table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-077 — The no-lookup info row appears only for typed documents](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-077.md) — When no schema is looked up because the workspace is not trusted or the document is outside every workspace folder, the extension SHALL show the info row "Schema validation requires a trusted workspace; showing generic frontmatter." if the frontmatter has a string `type`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-078 — At most 64 resolved schemas are kept](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-078.md) — When more than 64 schemas have been resolved, the extension SHALL drop the oldest resolved schema and release its compiled validator.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-079 — The bundle root defaults to the schema folder's parent](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-079.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.bundleRoot` is empty, the extension SHALL use the parent of the schema folder as the bundle root if it contains the document and an `index.md` or `log.md`.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-080 — The project root defaults to the nearest git root](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-080.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.projectRoot` is empty, the extension SHALL use the nearest folder with a `.git` entry above the document as the project root if it lies inside a workspace folder.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-081 — The allowOutsideWorkspaceLinks setting set to true allows outside links](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-081.md) — When `markdownOkfSchemaStudio.frontmatter.allowOutsideWorkspaceLinks` is true, the extension SHALL resolve a document-relative link to a file outside every workspace folder and allow navigating to it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-082 — A refused frontmatter link shows a warning with its reason](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-082.md) — When a frontmatter link is refused, the extension SHALL show the warning "Markdown OKF-Schema Studio could not follow the link: {reason}" with the problem message as the reason.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-083 — A malformed frontmatter link request is refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-083.md) — When the navigation request of a frontmatter link is malformed, the extension SHALL refuse it with the reason "The frontmatter link request is invalid.".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-084 — The frontmatter is validated against JSON Schema 2020-12](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-084.md) — When the frontmatter is validated, the extension SHALL apply the keywords of JSON Schema 2020-12 with formats.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-085 — The badge counts infos only when there is no error or warning](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-085.md) — When the frontmatter has info rows but no error and no warning, the extension SHALL show the count of infos in the title badge.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-086 — A link problem is keyboard-focusable and explained in its tooltip](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-086.md) — When a frontmatter link does not resolve, the extension SHALL make its text keyboard-focusable and carry the full "\[E10\]" or "\[W15\]" message in its tooltip.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-087 — A link problem counts in the badge](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-087.md) — When a frontmatter link does not resolve, the extension SHALL count the problem on the field row and in the title badge, without blocking the saving of other fields.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-088 — The generic table is shown when no schema lookup is made](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-088.md) — When no schema lookup is made for the document, the extension SHALL show the generic frontmatter table.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-089 — Every violation of the schema is reported](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMSCHEMA-089.md) — When the frontmatter violates the schema in several places, the extension SHALL report every violation, not only the first.
